title: The art of getting dressed, slowly
excerpt: Designers are returning to craft, considered pattern cutting, durable fibres and pieces intended to age with the wearer. The story argues that clothing can record attention rather than respond to a trend calendar.

title: A new language of light
excerpt: A coastal home uses thresholds, courtyard space, deep reveals, honed stone and timber grain to make natural light the primary decorative material.

title: Objects with a second life
excerpt: Independent makers use offcuts, failed casts, broken tiles and obsolete components as source material. Material histories guide dimensions and final forms.

title: The beauty of the in-between
excerpt: Artists, stylists and filmmakers work between disciplines. Their creative practice is connected by curiosity, cross-disciplinary references and community.

title: The room as a portrait
excerpt: An artist's home acts as an evolving archive of borrowed objects, drawings, inherited furniture and unfinished ideas. Collecting is a way of keeping ideas close.
